review_description: The sales and quoting process were smooth and punctual, as was the installation. Customer service was good, there was a problem with the hot water tripping but the installer came the very next day to rectify the problem.

Dean knows his stuff and is passionate about solar energy and the sale/quoting process was great in that he wasn't doing sales talk, simply presenting his experience. He cares about the quality of service and the only down side was that he gets so busy I sometimes had to wait  for a reply.  However, it is worth the wait and in actual fact my installation was done within two weeks of paying my deposit so there was no delay once we got the ball rolling.The installer was punctual, courteous and made sure the area was cleaned up and he helped me set up the app. Dean phoned to check that I knew how to work it and to answer any questions I might have.All in all a great seamless experience and I am delighted with the new system which looks fabulous and seems to be working beautifully. Time will tell as to just how much saving is generated.
Process was clear and smooth.Dean knows his stuff and his advice was thoughtful and useful.

I recently had Sunconnect Solar install a solar panel system and an EV charger at my home, and I couldn’t be happier with the results! The entire team (Dean and Peter) were professional, knowledgeable, and attentive to my needs. They guided me through every step of the process, from choosing the right system( Fronius Gen 24 Inverter and Wattpilot) to the final installation. The workmanship was top-notch, (as you can see from the photos) and they completed the project on schedule. I highly recommend Sunconnect Solar to anyone looking for quality solar and EV charger installations! Thanks Dean!

My experience with Dean was great. From the helpful conversations over the phone to day of the install. Was very helpful advice on were evening would be suitable for future infrastructure. Install was seamless and the cable management is awesome. Would absolutely recommend these guys. I will be using them again to get my battery and EV charger installed in the future!!

From the quoting process to the final installation, Sun Connect Solar were thorough and professional.10kw panels, inverter and battery fully installed within 2 (hot) days by Dean. His work was efficient and the site left tidy. Upon completion he showed me how to use and understand the app.

The quoting process was easy. No hi pressure selling. On the installation day the team came and installed all the equipment in a careful and professional manner. All the electricals were done by master electrician Dean. No outside contractors were needed as they do the whole job. After the job Dean organised the grid connection for me and explained how to work the inverter. The installation looks great and i am a happy customer.

Installer came when he said, knew his business made good suggestions .The installation took place over 2 days, the workers were polite and friendly, on the whole the installation was smooth and efficient.The Installer took responsibility for the whole project including the connection to the Isolar Cloud MoniterWe would and have recommended Sun Connect Solar to friends
Design met my specs and quality requirements at a fair cost.Installation was neat and organised with quality oversight.All good so far

Dean came out to discuss options and advise me on various possibilities.   He sent me two proposals which were very clearly laid out and easy to understand.  I felt confidant with Deans advise and settled on one of the proposals.  The job started quite soon after I sent a deposit and the install went very smoothly.  All in all the whole process went very smoothly and I feel confidant that I have a good system properly installed.  Thank you Dean.
Perfect communication and process from the quote to installation.Dean also set up wireless monitoring for us.Would highly recommend

Dean did a fantastic installation, very professional, courteous and took pride in his quality workmanship.Also took the time to explain how the system worked and best electricity plans to use Left the please very clean and tidy.Would highly recommend and will be using again.

We can recommend SunConnectSolar.The sales and quoting were very clear and detailed.Communication was prompt and supportiveInstallation was efficient, fast and problem free.All work was carried out in neat and tidy fashion.All systems were checked as were grid and app connections .Overall a very satisfying experience.

I heard from the installer within 30 minutes of requesting quotes off the website. Communication was helpful, consistent and timely. Once we had decided to go ahead with this company, dates were arranged and the work was carried out by an extremely friendly, trustworthy, punctual, polite and tidy crew. They even had great playlists and good humour to boot. Thoroughly happy from start to finish.
Very quick to contact me and provide a quote.  Installers were friendly and efficient.

The sales person was very competent, reliable and friendly. He was on time and installed the panels as promised and we paid exactly what he quoted. After installing the panels he took to old ones away at no costs. He also put the app on our phone and showed us how to check what the panels produce, how much we are using at the moment and how much gets fed into the grid. We highly recommend Dean from Sun Connect Solar. Anne and Ray

Dean was very easy to deal with from the initial contact, the quote, the install and our follow up questions. He is extremely passionate about his product. He knew everything! As soon as we placed the order he had it installed within the week. His communication was fantastic. We are very happy with the product and with the service that Dean and his team offered. Would highly recommend.

Exceptional service and customer care, including accredited design team of qualified Electrician and professional solar installers.They replaced my previous system which wasn't operating to full optimum capacity + recommended to take few steps to maximise my solar intake and production. They ensured the solar system is reliable, performs optimally and gave me robust warranty (10 years).I had some unavoidable shading issues which has been improved by Dean installing optimisers, which allow the system to perform at its best even on shady days and late afternoons when my trees make some shade.Super happy with my system and I recommend Dean and his team to friends and family.Highly recommended, punctual, quality product and outstanding service. Thank you Dean and Sun Connect Solar :)
